properties.source: Greenland–Iceland leg across the Denmark Strait narrows (~290 km), from the NW Iceland coast near Straumnes to the facing East Greenland coast; end points read off Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) land. The GIUK gap has no official line; this follows the common depiction of its two stretches either side of Iceland.
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9

properties.source: Iceland–Faroes leg: shortest crossing from east Iceland (Gerpir area) to the Faroes, end points read off Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) land. Conventional, not an official line.
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9

properties.source: Faroes–Shetland leg (Faroe–Shetland Channel), shortest crossing between the two on Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) land. Conventional; some depictions run to mainland Scotland instead.
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9
